fact: The catalogue line of the Auditor General's report on the 2024 accounts says the audit found the IFMIS without logs or offsite backup, which treats the system as operating in the 2024 financial year; the page holds no figures.

The Auditor General's report on the 2025 accounts audits the PMEC civil-service payroll as a running SAP system, finding workflow controls on only 8 of 29 infotypes, an unsupported Oracle database and no interface with IFMIS, with findings stated as at 31 August 2026.

The Zambia Revenue Authority presentation shows taxpayers filing returns on its TaxOnline system, using invoices generated by Smart Invoice, which has been mandatory for VAT-registered taxpayers since 1 July 2024.
A 2025 East African Finance Journal study by Sikabanga and Haabazoka finds the IFMIS digital platform in use in Zambian government ministries, with regular downtimes and weak support noted.
